decision: Rejected for release. Structured output is valid but model wrongly promotes distinct developments and uncertain identities to interchangeable coverage. A reference-only storage path cannot repair these classifier errors.

implementation_boundary.coverage: Only verified equivalent principal-event reports may enter complete-link coverage groups and shared consumption.
implementation_boundary.reference: Direct related-only reports need separately frozen source references; their read state and standalone eligibility must remain independent, including references outside the selected page cap.
implementation_boundary.transitivity: Both existing C partition implementations already require every internal coverage edge; reference edges must never enter either partition.
implementation_boundary.migration: Additive reference snapshots must leave existing frozen editions unchanged; changed prompt/result semantics require new preparation/task version and cache identity.

limitations: 24 previously explored pairs, not a representative independent holdout or generalization estimate.
New source-only labels define a different product contract; do not reinterpret prior strict-event evaluations as passing.
Request bodies use original frozen bounded representative evidence, not fetched full text.
Single run per pair in original stable story-ID order, no retry or swapped-order evaluation.
Local desktop helper only; no native provider or installed UI proof.
